products.name: Intune Custom Compliance & Configuration Items (Scripted) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable way to author, deploy, and manage custom compliance and configuration items in Intune — PowerShell detection scripts + JSON rules and scripted config items for the checks the built-in settings can't reach. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Enforce the checks Intune's built-in settings can't — with scripted custom compliance and config items

Intune's built-in compliance settings cover the basics, but real requirements go further: a registry value, a specific app version, a security control the GUI can't reach. The answer is custom compliance — a PowerShell detection script plus a JSON rule that Intune evaluates — and scripted configuration items for settings outside the templates. This solution gives you a repeatable way to author, deploy, and manage custom compliance and configuration items in Intune, so device state is measured and enforced exactly the way your standards require.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Intune custom compliance works (the detection script + JSON discovery rule + settings mapping), scripted configuration items / settings-catalog custom settings, how custom compliance feeds Conditional Access, and the authoring model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Entra ID, PowerShell script signing/execution, a compliance baseline, target groups, Conditional Access) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: write the detection script, author the JSON rule and settings mapping, upload as a custom compliance policy, add scripted configuration items, assign to a pilot, validate evaluation and Conditional Access effect, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — a custom-compliance detection-script template, a rule/JSON validation script, a fleet custom-compliance report, safe remediation of non-compliant devices, and a compliance-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Device state measured and enforced exactly to your standards — custom compliance detection scripts and scripted configuration items covering what the built-in settings can't, wired into Conditional Access — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CUSTCOMP-Discovery.ps1 — read the device-side values a custom-compliance detection script checks
    • CUSTCOMP-Remediation.ps1 — safely force an MDM sync so the custom compliance policy re-evaluates
    • CUSTCOMP-Report.ps1 — fleet-wide device compliance status + custom compliance policies (Graph)
    • CUSTCOMP-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the custom-compliance pilot/broad device groups (Graph)
    • CUSTCOMP-Validation.ps1 — validate a detection script + JSON rule pairing before upload

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
